personal_info.name: Vadym Alyekseyenko
personal_info.title: Applied AI & Automation Engineer
personal_info.tagline: I design, build, and operate production ERP data platforms, AI workflows, CRM systems, and field apps for a four-brand industrial group—working directly with leadership from business question to production. Remote EU / US.

summary: Applied AI and automation engineer. For six years I have designed, built, and operated the production systems of a four-brand industrial group (HABITARMOS / ESTORESRAINHA): ERP data, CRM, field app, quoting, and 80+ workflows. I ship the code myself, review junior and design work before release, and coach ~40 operators on the tools. Freelance practice ALYGEN: €20k+ closed after automated audits of 6,000+ companies. I partner directly with leadership to turn business questions into governed numbers—visibility on revenue, debt, stock, customers, and feedback—on a lean self-hosted stack.

highlights.label: Field & ops PWA in daily production

bullets: Architected a production PHC ERP cloud read replica (5M+ rows across 46 allowlisted tables in two company schemas, 15-min incremental sync, 99.1% uptime) with dbt semantic marts, Metabase executive dashboards, and read-only MCP metric tools so leadership and CRM run on governed data instead of on-prem SQL.

Built the HABITAI operations cockpit across four brands: read-only MCP agent orchestration, multimodal RAG (Docling, ColPali, Qdrant), predictive inventory, Distribution 360, and executive KPI dashboards.
Scaled 80+ production workflows (n8n, Zoho Flow, Make.com) to ~22.5k n8n runs per week and ~4k Zoho Flow runs per month for ERP-CRM sync, operational alerts, and automated failure monitoring.

Founded and run the 55-project Innovation Hub (~465h/month saved, ~28-day average delivery), prioritizing and shipping internal automations across commercial, warehouse, accounting, and marketing (including carrier alerts, marketing Kanban sync, and order-to-CRM intake).
I design and ship the production systems myself. I review junior developer and design work before release, and I coach ~40 people in sales, warehouse, and operations on CRM, BI, and the daily tools.

experience.role: Senior AI Systems and Automation Engineer
bullets: Built ZohoSync (PHC SQL Server to Zoho Bigin EU) for 500+ distributors: synced 893 accounts, 2,405 contacts, and ~2k pipeline records so reps track targets, gap-to-goal, and stalled deals live.

Led ESTORESRAINHA digital turnaround for 15k+ customers (~11.4k migrated into Twenty CRM with NIF deduplication): replaced paper workflows with automated scheduling, catalog sync, service tracking, and agent-assisted CRM ingestion.

Shipped and extended app-tecnicos (https://github.com/alyekseyenko/services-blinds), an offline-first field operations PWA (Dexie sync, Twenty CRM GraphQL, transactional outbox, PDF/XLSX measurements, on-site repair payments, CEO metrics, HMAC customer rating) in production for ~20 people with 640+ Vitest tests.

Engineered the orcamentos-ia quoting platform (FastAPI, React): 124k+ deterministic pricing tiers across 20+ supplier price-list plug-ins with Docling/Celery PDF ingestion, cutting multi-brand quote turnaround from days to minutes with zero price hallucination.

Built the group's web footprint from zero across 4 brands: corporate sites habitarmos.com and estoresrainha.com (custom HTML/CSS) and high-traffic catalog properties arkitek.pt and skuba.com.pt (WordPress), scaling ARKITEK/SKUBA to 15k+ combined monthly visits through technical SEO and catalog storytelling.
Automated product visual generation with custom Stable Diffusion SDXL LoRAs via ComfyUI and built multimodal computer-vision pipelines for SKU matching and catalog synchronization.

experience.role: Freelance B2B Automation & Digital Services Consultant
bullets: Run ALYGEN, the trading name for my freelance B2B services (web, automation, and digital operations for SMBs): closed €20k+ in client work after prospecting 6,000+ companies with automated audits.

Built Alygen CRM, my own sales tool (https://github.com/alyekseyenko/alygen), scaling outreach from ~4 to ~200 leads/day with sub-3-minute proposals via Chromium audits, ML lead scoring, and multi-agent Email, WhatsApp, and Telegram dispatch (React, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector).
Long-term e-commerce and events client: three production sites from zero, inbound leads from ~2/week to ~5-10/day, with e-commerce and event ticketing still running after 3+ years.

projects.title: PHC ERP · Cloud Read Replica & Semantic Layer
projects.problem: Two companies ran on separate on-prem ERP databases and Excel—CRM, automation, and leadership had no single trusted view of revenue, debt, stock, or customers.
projects.built: Outbound-only Python incremental sync into PostgreSQL, dbt semantic marts (67 models, 114 tests), Metabase executive dashboards, and read-only MCP metric tools.
impact: 5M+ rows across 46 allowlisted tables on a 15-minute incremental cadence (99.1% 7-day sync success)
Single reconciled metrics catalog with daily ERP checks and a 49-question regression suite (unaudited revenue visibility; accountant sign-off pending)
Decoupled ~11.4k CRM customer migrations and executive BI from on-prem SQL Server

projects.title: HABITAI · Unified Operations Cockpit
projects.problem: Operational data lived across ERP, CRM, logistics, and spreadsheets with no shared cockpit for owners or commercial teams.
projects.built: Multi-brand Next.js and FastAPI cockpit unifying governed ERP metrics, read-only MCP Q&A, multimodal technical RAG, Distribution 360, debt auditing, and predictive inventory.
impact: Read-only MCP orchestration over governed dbt marts so leadership queries live KPIs safely
Multimodal RAG pipeline (Docling, ColPali, Qdrant, BGE/Jina rerankers) for technical product consultation
Distribution 360, debt investigator, and predictive inventory over ~7.1k active SKUs by unit of measure

projects.title: app-tecnicos · Field Operations PWA
projects.problem: Field installation and warehouse prep ran on WhatsApp, spreadsheets, and phone calls with no live visit state when customers called.
projects.built: Offline-first Next.js PWA with Dexie IndexedDB sync, transactional outbox, Twenty CRM GraphQL contract layer, PDF/XLSX measurements, CEO metrics, and HMAC customer rating portals.
impact: In daily production for ~20 people across field, warehouse, dispatch, and management
640+ Vitest unit tests, Playwright smoke E2E, GitHub Actions CI, and a 600-line file-size ratchet (zero god files)
Offline capture survives dead zones and reconciles cleanly to Twenty CRM without duplicate writes

projects.title: orcamentos-ia · Multi-Supplier Quoting Core
projects.problem: Multi-brand quoting relied on manual PDF and spreadsheet lookup across 20+ suppliers—sales and technicians waited days while unit prices had to stay auditable.
projects.built: Modular FastAPI and React platform with per-supplier pricing plug-ins, Docling/Celery PDF ingestion, deterministic width×height pricing, and tool-only LLM line-item assistance.
impact: 124k+ deterministic pricing tiers across 20+ supplier catalogs with zero price hallucination
Collapsed quote turnaround from days to minutes with frozen, auditable unit prices per proposal
Writes proposals directly into Twenty CRM alongside measurements from the field PWA

projects.title: ZohoSync · ERP-to-CRM Commercial Intelligence
projects.problem: Commercial leadership tracked a 500+ distributor network on disconnected spreadsheets instead of live ERP-backed objectives and stalled-deal signals.
projects.built: FastAPI and Redis incremental bridge syncing PHC SQL Server into Zoho Bigin EU with live rep KPIs, gap-to-target tracking, and geospatial distributor analytics.
impact: Synced 893 accounts, 2,405 contacts, and ~2k pipeline records for live commercial tracking
Surfaces gap-to-target, stalled deals, and at-risk accounts across 500+ distributors
Feeds HABITAI commercial coaching views and executive reporting

projects.title: Container Risk Radar · Fleet Observability
projects.problem: Multi-brand websites, containers, hosts, and 80+ workflows were monitored across separate tools, turning incident triage into manual log hunting.
projects.built: Docker Compose observability stack with Prometheus, Loki, Grafana Alloy, Alertmanager, a Python YAML-weighted risk engine, and a Next.js SSE dashboard.
impact: Computes an explainable per-container risk score (0.0-1.0) across containers, hosts, and n8n workflows
Routes live degradation and sync-failure alerts directly to Slack and Telegram
Replaced manual multi-tool checks with one operational view for early failure detection

projects.title: Alygen CRM · B2B Audit & Outreach Engine

projects.built: Open-source polyglot CRM (React, Node.js Express, Python FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector, SQLite WAL failover) with 12+ Chromium audits, RandomForest scoring, and multi-channel dispatch.
impact: Closed €20k+ in freelance B2B work after prospecting and auditing 6,000+ SMBs
Scaled outreach from ~4 to ~200 leads/day with localized proposals generated in under 3 minutes
Backed by 65+ automated tests (Vitest, Pytest) and GitHub Actions CI

380k+ lifetime LFG requests tracked with ~+35% higher channel activity after migration
Containerized with Docker Compose and automated CI (pytest, ruff, mypy)
